description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order to require the Director General of Customs to demand and levy on each article from 18.04.2018
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the issuance of a Revenue Protection Order under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962. It details changes to import duty rates on specific goods (gold), which constitutes a regulatory change to customs/tariff legislation. This fits the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for customs and revenue protection. While it mentions a minister's name, the core content is regulatory, not about government personnel or structure.
